# Montgomery Advertiser

> > Montgomery Advertiser is Alabama's leading news source covering Montgomery and the River Region, with comprehensive local news, business, opinion, and interactive data tools tracking severe weather events including tornadoes and wildfires.

The Montgomery Advertiser serves Montgomery, Alabama and surrounding River Region communities with breaking news, investigative journalism, and data-driven reporting. The publication provides specialized coverage of Alabama weather patterns and natural disasters, including historical tornado tracking since 1950 using NOAA data and real-time wildfire monitoring across the state.

## Key Topics

- Montgomery, Alabama
- River Region news
- Alabama tornadoes
- Tornado tracking and Fujita scale
- Wildfire tracking and smoke maps
- Red flag warnings
- NOAA weather data
- Local business coverage
- Storm damage and severe weather
- Historical weather data
- Montgomery County
- Tuscaloosa
- Interactive mapping tools
- Community journalism

## News & Coverage

- [Montgomery Advertiser Homepage](https://eu.montgomeryadvertiser.com/): Homepage for Montgomery, Alabama news and regional coverage
- [Local and River Region News](https://www.montgomeryadvertiser.com/news/): Montgomery and River Region local news aggregation and updates
- [Business Section](https://www.montgomeryadvertiser.com/news/business/): Montgomery and River Region business news, stocks, and economy coverage
- [Opinion & Commentary](https://www.montgomeryadvertiser.com/opinion/): Opinion columns, editorials, and letters from Montgomery, Alabama

## Weather & Emergency Data Tools

- [Alabama Tornado Archive](https://data.montgomeryadvertiser.com/tornado-archive/): Interactive map tracking Alabama tornadoes since 1950 using NOAA data
- [Wildfire Smoke Map](https://data.montgomeryadvertiser.com/fires/): Real-time wildfire tracking map for Alabama with hourly updates
- [Historical Weather Data](https://data.montgomeryadvertiser.com/weather-data/worcester-county/24047/1903-03-01/): Historical weather data for Worcester County, MD since 1895 from NCEI
